item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02490","case1_error":"Treats 45 training days as 45 weeks, omitting division by five training days per week.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written subtraction 140 − 85 as 45 instead of 55.","reason":"The first fails to convert days into weeks; the second numerically miscalculates a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02491","case1_error":"Counts the other walker's dogs as having two legs each, then rounds the resulting noninteger dog count.","case2_error":"Equates dog and cat owners with all citizens, ignoring that only 60% own pets.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect per-dog leg count. The second equates a subset with the whole population; this error persists regardless of whom 'half' describes.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02492","case1_error":"Uses 12 birds per snake instead of the stated three, substituting the beetle consumption rate.","case2_error":"Counts all ten people as adults and adds four children, although the children are included in the ten.","reason":"The first substitutes the wrong consumption rate; the second double-counts a subgroup by treating the total as its complementary subgroup.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02493","case1_error":"Constructs incorrect population ratios, including moose per human as 1/(2/19), instead of 1/(2 × 19).","case2_error":"Evaluates 15 + 10 − 6 as 29 instead of 19, then asserts zero from the resulting contradiction.","reason":"The first writes erroneous ratio relations; the second miscalculates a correctly written inclusion-exclusion expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02494","case1_error":"Evaluates 48 − 17 − 10 as 11 instead of 21.","case2_error":"Subtracts missed school days from seven calendar days instead of the five scheduled school days.","reason":"The first numerically evaluates a correct expression incorrectly; the second constructs the attendance calculation using the wrong starting quantity.","judgment":"different"}]}
